name: EYA transcriptional coactivator and phosphatase 4

function.text: EYA4 is the approved symbol for EYA transcriptional coactivator and phosphatase 4. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in protein tyrosine phosphatase activity; anatomical structure morphogenesis; cell differentiation.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include nonsyndromic genetic hearing loss (autosomal dominant); autosomal dominant nonsyndromic hearing loss 10 (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Lung adenocarcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma; Endometrial carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.
